title: The Echo of the Rust Belt
author: Dominic Eriksen
blurb: Hazel Reyes, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
